headline: The photo can lie in six ways now
lede: Papers, Please-Min's portrait check grew from four compared features to six — thick vs thin brows, open vs shut mouths — and the passport photo became a zoom-crop portrait with whites in its eyes, a nose and ears. Every new forgery names itself at the counter; the eyes just have to catch it.

notes.text: PORTRAIT compares brow thickness and mouth shape now — a forger flips exactly one of six features and the deny prints which one (PHOTO BROWS THICK, ENTRANT THIN).
The ID photo is a zoom-crop: the head reads ~50px where it used to be a 40px smudge, painted with sclera and pupils, brows, nose, ears and two mouth shapes.

The harness grew a coverage witness: all six features must actually forge across the seed sweep, and 24 mutants probe the seam — the shrunk-back-to-four mutant is caught by coverage alone, since verdicts stay fair without it.
Prod verify lost 10 minutes to an edge-pinned entry HTML — the fix is a cache-bust query on the entry plus -r on the grep, then the payload string shows up on the first poll.

look.text: Study the new photo at the booth — papers-please, seed 1
